title: a kedvenc zeném: My Favourite Music

sections.title: Whose favourite is it?
sections.content: You already know kedvenc ("favourite"). Add a possessive suffix to the noun that follows it to say whose favourite you mean: a kedvenc zeném ("my favourite music"), a kedvenc éneked ("your favourite song"), a kedvenc zenekara ("his/her favourite band").

items.english: I listen to my favourite music most of all.

sections.content: kedvenc itself never changes form — only the noun after it takes the possessive suffix. Don't be tempted to add anything to kedvenc; it just sits in front like an ordinary adjective.
